audit: T3 grade-separation source semantics and exact tract aggregation; diagnostic-only

measure_before.preexisting_rule: eligible class rows are marked when level_rules contains a dict whose value is not null/zero OR road_flags contains any frozen grade-separation value; each marked source row is counted in each intersecting tract

method.aggregation_rule: one count for each marked input row whose geometry intersects an official tract; exact source-row ID plus tract ID is the pair key
method.duplicate_geometry_policy: identical WKB geometries are reported, not collapsed; distinct input rows remain distinct segments
method.independent_reference: bounded-batch spatial-tree enumeration of marked source row/tract pairs, independently counted and compared to production density rescaled by official ALAND
method.marking_rule: one boolean mark per eligible source row: any non-null/nonzero level_rules.value OR any road_flags.values entry casefold-matching the frozen list
method.registered_reader: T3 from provided Overture roads-unfiltered; official ACS tract geometries and ALAND only
